mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average signals an expansion in economic demand, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above its 3-month moving average signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of payroll employment growth above its 3-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts above its 6-month moving average, combined with a rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average, signals a strong demand for housing and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of housing starts and GDP growth above their respective 6-month moving averages (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above its 6-month moving average, combined with an increase in the federal funds rate above 1%, signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of CPI growth above its 6-month moving average and federal funds rate above 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 3-month moving average signals a decrease in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of industrial production decline below its 3-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 10% signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 10% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales above its 6-month moving average, combined with a decline in the unemployment rate below 8%, signals a strong demand for consumer goods and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of retail sales growth above its 6-month moving average and unemployment rate below 8% (t-test p > 0.05).
